note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

MEASURED, NOT ARGUED, and measured on BOTH trees in ONE environment by the same scripts/route-graph.mjs with the same node: origin/main checked out detached in a throwaway worktree, its own fleet re-pinned to main's committed lock shas, lands EXACTLY on all four of its committed ceilings (/api/mcp 1768, /chat 1870, /api/a2a 1776, /api/llm-bridge 1786 — headroom 0 on each), and the merged tree measures /api/mcp 1786, /chat 1888, /api/a2a 1794, /api/llm-bridge 1804. The raise is therefore +18 on each of the four routes and the whole of it is this branch's: nothing of main's is folded into it. WHAT THE EIGHTEEN ARE, carried forward from this pull request's own earlier measurement of the same modules rather than re-isolated here: the three display packs this wave adds (cms-snapshot-artifact, screenshot-artifact and slide-deck-artifact) arriving on the shared store spine all four routes already reach. The FOUR modules this pull request's previous record also carried — the versioned artifact content channel's read (cinatra#3047) — are no longer part of this branch's raise: main now reaches them itself, which is why the same merged absolute counts that were +22 over main's older ceilings are +18 over these. The growth is ADDITIVE: no module leaves any route's reachable set. Narrowing is unavailable — a display pack is reachable from the store spine by construction, and scripts/route-graph.mjs counts a dynamic import() specifier as the same first-party graph pressure as a static one, so deferring an edge would not lower the measured count. /sign-in reaches none of it and measures 163 on BOTH trees, below the 223 ceiling it carries, so it keeps main's committed ceiling and main's own cinatra#2988 record UNEDITED — a forward merge neither raises nor moves an untouched route's ceiling. The PR 3302 records main committed for these four routes are RETIRED BY THIS RAISE, the one lifecycle the gate allows for an annotation whose ceiling moves.
